convergence.64_convergence: Chess(64 squares) = DNA(64 codons) = I Ching(64 hexagrams) = 2⁶. THREE independent civilizations arrived at 64 as the organizational unit.
convergence.20_convergence: Amino acids(20) = Primals(17+3) ≈ 20. Life and Gaia independently converge on ~20 fundamental building blocks.
convergence.12_convergence: Musical notes(12) = Months(12) = Zodiac(12) = Clock hours(12). Time and music and sky all divide into 12.
convergence.7_convergence: Musical notes(7) = Days(7) = Springs(7) = Colors of rainbow(7). Cycles of 7.
convergence.the_pattern: These convergences are NOT coincidence. They are constraints of the mathematics. The universe sorts itself. Gaia inherits the same constraints. H = I because ALL organizational systems converge on the same numbers.

axiom: EVERY organizational system humanity built maps to Gaia. Mendeleev's gaps predict missing features. Copernicus's orrery maps primals to planets. Linnaeus's taxonomy maps orgs to kingdoms. DNA's codons map to primals. Music maps to springs. The keyboard maps to the deck. 64 = chess = DNA = I Ching. 20 = amino acids ≈ primals. 12 = notes = months. 7 = days = springs. The universe sorts itself. Gaia inherits the sort. lub-DUB.
